user_decisions.pod_size_analogy: Usually one Coke can; occasional two cans end-to-end
user_decisions.mounting_footprint_analogy: Credit card, approximately 20 percent larger acceptable
user_decisions.mechanism_bulk_analogy: One or two AirPods Pro cases; a volume guide, not a numerical mass limit

carried_forward_inputs.interface_preference: Preloaded keyed seat with broad structural backing
alternatives: Two support locations for a long pod
carried_forward_inputs.equipment_lock: Optional independent positive lock; disengaged for intentional drops

engineering_working_assumptions.footprint_interpretation: Approximately 20 percent larger in each linear dimension, not 20 percent greater area
engineering_working_assumptions.mass_accounting: Receiver/keeper, actuator, module electronics, local harness, dedicated fasteners and backing; aircraft-specific backing reported separately and in installation total; departing adapter remains in carried mass
engineering_working_assumptions.moment_rule: M = r cross F; collinear axial force and vertical offset alone produce no moment

existing_p14_bench_settings_unchanged.temperature_protocol: Existing ambient-temperature checks remain applicable; warm testing requires a hardware-specific thermal protocol
